source.name: L'Équipe: Le sponsor maillot de l'équipe de France de rugby va-t-il changer dès cet été ?
source.quote: la marque Altrad s'affichera sur le maillot des Bleus cet été, à l'occasion du Championnat des nations qui verra le quinze de France jouer en Nouvelle-Zélande (4 juillet), en Australie (11 juillet) et au Japon (18 juillet), et jusqu'au 30 juin 2027, ce qui inclut donc le prochain Tournoi des Six Nations
source.note: L'Équipe (live page 403s scripts; archived copy opened) reports the one-year extension ('avenant') keeping the Altrad name on the front of the France shirt until 30 June 2027, i.e. the whole 2026-27 season. The official FFR shop product photos of the current Adidas home shirt (replica and player-issue, opened 4 Oct 2026) show the large white ALTRAD wordmark centre chest.

source.name: Société Générale: Sponsoring du rugby — l'engagement de Société Générale
source.quote: Société Générale est désormais présent au dos de tous les maillots des équipes de France.
source.note: The bank's own site states: 'Société Générale is now on the back of all the French national teams' shirts' — the 'haut du dos de maillot' rights for all France teams were acquired in its 2024-2028 'partenaire premium' deal (News Tank Sport, 19 Nov 2024). The official partner-shop photos of the current home shirt show SOCIETE GENERALE across the upper back.

source.name: News Tank Sport: FFR — Société Générale et Renault, premiers sponsors dos de maillot et short des équipes de France
source.quote: vont devenir respectivement sponsor dos de maillot et sponsor short des équipes de France de rugby pour un cycle qui ira du 01/01/2024 au 31/12/2027
source.note: FFR president Florian Grill told News Tank that Société Générale (shirt back) and Renault Group (shorts) won the bidding for the 01/01/2024-31/12/2027 rights cycle — the current one. The match shorts carry the sponsor; the replica home shorts sold on boutique.ffr.fr and rugbyshop.com (checked 4 Oct 2026) show only the rooster crest and the Adidas mark: replicas omit the shorts sponsor.

source.name: SportBusiness.Club: En attendant CMA CGM, la FFR annonce cinq nouveaux sponsors
source.quote: La FFR a également officialisé la prolongation de son contrat d’équipementier avec Adidas pour dix années supplémentaires, jusqu’en 2036
source.note: Adidas has made the France kits since November 2025; on 1 October 2026 the FFR officially extended the kit-maker contract by ten years, to 2036 (English: 'FFR ... extended its kit-supplier contract with Adidas ... until 2036'). Kit maker, listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers.

summary: France plays the 2026-27 internationals in the Adidas home shirt launched in November 2025 (first worn 8 Nov 2025 against South Africa, still the current match shirt for the Nations Championship and Six Nations 2027). Altrad sits centre front, extended to 30 June 2027; Société Générale is on the upper back; Renault Group holds the shorts placement for the current rights cycle. Adidas makes the kit (contract extended to 2036). Official shop and partner-shop photos show plain sleeves and crest-plus-Adidas shorts: no other commercial marks. Altrad (owned by Mohed Altrad) and Société Générale both have recorded issues to weigh: a 2026 tax-fraud investigation and a 2022 first-instance corruption conviction (Mohed Altrad, appeal pending) — excluded categories under METHOD.md — and a September 2025 Paris Court of Appeal discrimination finding against Société Générale, proposed as Concern.
shortLine: Altrad on the front, Société Générale on the back
